title: Travel Card Blocked
scenario: A bank text says your travel card is blocked and asks for full card details.

answers.A: Call the number on the back of the card.
answers.B: Send the full card number and security code by text.
answers.C: Reply with the last four digits so the bank can identify you.
answers.D: Open the banking app yourself and check the card status.

explanation: A blocked-card message can be used to collect enough data for a second attack. Use the card or app known route.
proTip: When a card is involved, trust the card printed number, not the text.
